replies.text: WelcomeMilk89 You've probably noticed that Tuta offers you two options when opening an account: wait 48 hours or send them an email requesting approval. Send them the email and you'll have it within a few hours. It's an anti-spam measure.

replies.text: I've created two account on GOS, waited the 24h approval window and both of them were confirmed after that. It has nothing to do with GOS imo.

replies.author: WelcomeMilk89
replies.text: AKRAKU I had an account approved, but it was done on my old Samsung. Was able to install the app on my phone and use it, but for some reason I just was unable to create any accounts on my phone. Definitely not blaming GOS or anything, just an observation as the phone was the only constant that produced the same issue. It could very well be some settings on my GOS that caused the problem...
